description:
AI Performance Engineer    

 Dell's Client Product Group (CPG) is seeking an AI Performance Engineer to join the PC Systems Performance team. In this role, you will build foundational expertise in system-level performance engineering by using AI and working alongside senior engineers to optimize the design of next-generation PC platforms. You'll tackle performance characterization, power efficiency, thermal optimization, and acoustic tuning across mobile and desktop systems. Our team thrives on creativity and enjoys significant design freedom to bring the latest technologies into Dell's award-winning consumer and commercial products. 

 What you’ll achieve:   

 As an AI Performance Engineer, you will work at the forefront of technology, driven by a team that has a passion for innovation, harnessing each other's strengths, & radiates a strong sense of camaraderie. 

 Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an AI   Performance Engineer on our  TPPA  team in Austin, Texas .  


 You will:   

 Contribute to developing autonomous tools for the execution of performance benchmarks, lab automation, and system characterization tests on PC platforms. 
 Develop/apply AI-assisted tools to analyze performance data to identify optimization opportunities and present findings with clear visualizations and recommendations 
 Collaborate with performance architects, firmware teams, and product managers to drive performance strategy and deliver competitive solutions 
 Learn performance engineering fundamentals including benchmarking methodologies, power efficiency, thermals, and competitive analysis 
 Perform hands-on technical work including test system setup, hardware configuration, and basic troubleshooting 
 

 Take the first step towards your dream career   

 Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:  

 Essential Requirements   

 Proficiency with Windows operating systems, system configuration, and BIOS interfaces 

 Understanding of PC hardware (CPUs, GPUs, memory, storage, thermals) and how components impact system performance 

 Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and organized—able to manage test runs independently and maintain accurate records 

 Comfortable with data tools (AI Harnesses, Excel, Vibe code, Python, SQL) and hands-on technical work (hardware assembly, configuration, troubleshooting) 

 Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to present technical findings and work effectively across teams 

  
 Desirable Requirements   

 BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related engineering field 

 Experience with performance benchmarking (Cinebench, 3DMark, PCMark) or PC building, gaming, or overclocking 

 Familiarity with performance tools (Windows Performance Toolkit, ETW, BIOS tuning) or scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, SQL) 

 Experience with data visualization or analysis tools (Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) 

 Familiarity with measurement equipment (power analyzers, multimeters, thermal cameras) or AI-assisted productivity tools 

  
 Compensation 
 Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $112,200 - $145,200.  
 Benefits and Perks of working at Dell Technologies 
 Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Dell Technologies team member right now at MyWellatDell.com.
